critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 2142: RustAnalyzeRequest.method is typed as free-form `str = 'zone'` — any value is accepted and normalized by _norm_method. Consider Literal['zone','full'] or 422 for invalid method for stricter contract (minor).

server.py 2417: rust_locate_grid 400 path checks `RustRecord(**doc).method_results.get('zone')` — because the RustRecord model_validator auto-populates method_results[rec.method] from top-level fields, a legacy record whose active method is `full` and never had a 'zone' snapshot will correctly 400, but a record that was analyzed only with 'zone' (default) will always satisfy this check. OK as designed.
server.py 2200: _norm_method() normalizes unknown method strings silently to 'zone' — this is lenient but means a typo in client payload will NOT trigger a 400. Document or tighten (minor).

server.py 2454: _set_active_rust_method persists the CURRENT active snapshot before switching, which may overwrite a prior manual correction on the outgoing method if top-level changed outside PUT scope. In practice PUT already keeps method_results in sync so this is a no-op. Watch when adding future direct top-level mutations.

AI vision end-to-end (POST /api/rust/analyze/start method='full' and POST /method/analyze) was NOT executed to preserve Gemini budget.
